items.title: Joseph Rene Interview, 1960-09-08
items.q: Lester and the kid drummer, his name begins with an L, Leon.

ctx.x: Oh, yeah, it's Lester who's the cousin I think. Yeah, yeah, yeah. Lester and the kid drummer, his name begins with an L, Leon. Leon, yeah. Lee and Lester, they're two brothers. Uh-huh. And they're cousins to the other two.
I was a fine musician, boy, and he was a perfect drunkard, amateur drunkard. Who's that? Spurt.
